CustomField.description: Admin-editable runtime weights, keyed by dimension DeveloperName. Example: {"Completeness":0.30,"Structure":0.20,"Clarity":0.10,"Freshness":0.10,"Duplication":0.15,"Conflict":0.15}. Stored as Text because hierarchy custom settings do not allow LongTextArea. When empty or missing a key, falls back to KB_Scoring_Dimension__mdt.Default_Weight__c.
CustomField.label: Weights JSON
